degradedReason: No sub-agent/Task tool available (assessments run inline) and no browser in sandbox, so Assessment B uses the local detector only, not live screenshot evidence.

findings.detail: Space Grotesk is an overused/AI-default display face. Brutalist spec chose it deliberately; consider a more distinctive grotesque if differentiation matters.

assessmentA_heuristics.rating: Acceptable (20-27): significant improvements needed before users are happy

cognitive_load.verdict: Low cognitive load. Screens are single-focus; mode grid is 3 cards (<=4); nav is labeled. Minor: auto-hiding navbar can hide location cues.

issues.title: Yellow text on light paper fails contrast everywhere
issues.detail: Headlines/brand use --accent-yellow (#F6C500) as TEXT on --paper (#F3EFE3) / --paper-raised (#FAF7EE). Measured ~1.4:1 and ~1.5:1. WCAG needs 3:1 for large text, 4.5:1 for normal. Affected: .logo, .welcome-section h2, .leaderboard-header h2, .login-box h2, .game-header h2, .game-message h2, .score-value. The brand wordmark is effectively unreadable.
issues.fix: Headings/brand text should be --ink (#111) on paper. Keep yellow as FILL (header strips, active-nav fill, button hover, yellow text only on dark/ink surfaces). Score value -> ink or yellow-on-ink block.

issues.title: Red/green accent text fails 4.5:1 at normal size
issues.detail: Red #D8402C (~3.9:1) and green #1F8A52 (~3.8:1) pass for large/bold but FAIL for normal-size text on paper. Affected: .login-required-note, .nav-btn.logout, .btn-try-again text, .lobby-session-id code, .waiting-message strong.
issues.fix: Use ink for normal-size accent text; reserve red/green for large/bold, fills, or borders. Or darken the accents for text use.

issues.title: Focus outline (yellow) low-contrast on paper
issues.detail: button:focus-visible/a:focus-visible outline is 3px solid --accent-yellow on paper -> poor visibility for keyboard users.
issues.fix: Use a high-contrast focus ring: 3px solid --ink with offset, or a double ring (ink + paper). Yellow ring only acceptable on dark surfaces.

issues.title: Idle/liveness motion from the brutalist spec is not implemented
issues.detail: DESIGN.md section 7 calls for live-data ticks, status-tag pulses, corner-tag jitter, and staggered stamp entrances to keep the UI from feeling static. None are wired (needs JSX/data + CSS). Currently the only motion is hover/press + chomp.
issues.fix: Run $impeccable animate frontend to add the snap-eased idle/stamp motion without glow.

issues.title: Space Grotesk is an overused display face
issues.detail: Detector warning: Space Grotesk converges with other AI-default faces. The brutalist spec chose it deliberately, so this is a preference call, not a defect.
issues.fix: Keep, or swap the display face for a more distinctive grotesque if brand differentiation matters.

issues.title: Hard offset shadows can clip at viewport edges
issues.detail: 8px/10px solid ink shadows + translate(-2px,-2px) hover on cards/buttons can be clipped by .app-container/.content overflow at the screen edges; heavy shadows also add visual weight.
issues.fix: Ensure containers have enough padding (>= shadow offset) or inset the shadow on edge elements; acceptable as-is for brutalist intent.

issues.title: Error/empty-state copy not reviewed
issues.detail: Empty states exist (.no-friends, .no-data) but error-message copy and recovery guidance were not inspected in JSX.
issues.fix: Run $impeccable clarify frontend to harden UX copy and error messages.
